svg.title: Cross-view optimization diagram comparing ambiguous original 3D-GS and CVO constrained joint optimization
svg.desc: Base frames: f01 contains the initial point cloud, f02 contains the ground-truth Gaussian splat, f03 contains the top no-CVO optimization comparison, and f04 contains the bottom with-CVO optimization comparison. Conduction drawing inventories: f01 includes a dotted point cloud of an outdoor scene, title text, a highlighted red origin point, and an outgoing initialization arrow. f02 includes title text and a sparse ground-truth arrangement of three colored camera frustums and two green/yellow Gaussian splats. f03 includes iteration-i title without CVO, iteration-i+1 title without CVO, independent camera views, green splats, curved arrows, three black question arrows, possible result labels, ambiguous transformed splats, and camera frustums. f04 includes iteration-i title with CVO, iteration-i+1 title with CVO, correlated camera/splat geometry, green annotation, and the ground-truth direction arrow. Symmetry basis: the two right panels are vertically aligned and equal width; left top and bottom frames share the same left and right edges; right-panel contents are horizontally partitioned into iteration-i construction and iteration-i+1 outcomes.

text.tspan: Insufficient constraints and random-view-select training strategy brings ambiguous optimization results.
More constrained and accurate gaussian splat within two iterations.
